card.name: Inside long split-up words
card.fires_on: Responds to a middle piece of a longer word that is split into parts, often a medical or technical term such as valgus, hypertonia, pharmacodynamic or SGOT. The word is not yet finished at that point.

modes.label: Medical term pieces
modes.description: A middle or end piece inside a long clinical term or abbreviation.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: A piece inside a rarer non-medical word or code term.
modes.example: member functions r<<begin>> and rend that return reverse iterators

card.plain: It fires partway through long, rare words like medical terms that the model reads in several pieces.
